- **Recurrence:** a ticked recurring task reopens with its next date (fixed schedule, or counted from today with `after`); a list cycle un-ticks every task at its reset date (stamps only `done`, plus ticked subtasks).
- A failed save raises an inbox item (`save-fail:<hour>`). Only the Undo toast is local (`#toast`); every plain message goes through `orosNotifs.transient` (TD-11, local fallback when standalone); confirm is a native `<dialog>` built in JS; dialogs are centred by `dialog { margin: auto }` in `todo.css`.
- Debug handle `window.__todoDebug` = `{ merge, canon, state() }`.

### Notes app (`notes/`) [verified 2026-10-07, `?v=0.39.18`; header "v0.17.0"]

- `notes/index.html` (tree pane, splitter, title input, `#md-toolbar`, `#page-body` = textarea + `#page-preview`), `notes/notes.js` (one IIFE, ES5), `notes/md.js` (pure, `window.OrosNotesMd`, Node-tested in `tests/notes-md.test.js`), `notes/notes.css`. Footer buttons, notebook menu button, Today button, toolbar buttons, chips, link strip, search overlay, tag panel, menus and dialogs are built by JS. Pages are stored as plain text (Markdown source); `[[wiki links]]` and backlinks are computed live, nothing stored.
- **Keys:** `oros-notes-data` (synced slice `notes`), `oros-notes-prefs` (device-local: open nodes, current page, current notebook, tree width, `view` edit | preview | split).
- **Schema (`DATA_VER` 3):** `{ ver, notebooks[{ id, name, mtime, pos }], pages[{ id, nb, parent, title, text, mtime, pos, labels[], pinned, ct, st, h[], hx?, cf? }], labels[{ id, nb, name, color, mtime, pos }], tombs{ <pageId> | "lbl:"+id | "nb:"+id : ts } }`.
- **Three clocks per page (NO-3):** `mtime` = anything changed (life and death against tombs); `st` = structure changed (pin, position, parent, notebook, labels; `touchStruct`); `ct` = title or text changed (`touchContent`). `h` = content stamps this text descends from, one step per sync round (`editedSinceSync` is cleared whenever the engine reads or writes the slice), at most 60 (`hx` = truncated). A page whose `mtime` is newer than both `ct` and `st` was last touched by a device on the previous `notes.js`: for that version `mtime` speaks for everything (`touchedByOldCode`).
- **Merge (`mergeNotesStates`):** tombs union (max); notebooks and labels per-id LWW by `mtime` (tie → lexicographic JSON) minus tombs; dead notebook references are repaired BEFORE two versions are compared; pages per id through `mergePage`: structure from the newer `st` (tie → key of the fields the merge never rewrites), content from the newer `ct`, `mtime` = max. If the two texts differ, the losing one is not empty and the winner does not descend from it (`descendsFrom`), the losing text becomes a page `"<id>~c<ct>"` with `cf:1` next to the original (a tomb on that id keeps it deleted). The result goes through `canonNotes`.
- **Canonical form (`canonNotes`, NO-2), used by the getter AND the merge:** fixed key order per entity, notebooks and labels by (pos, id), pages by (mtime, id), `ct` / `st` always spelled out, tombstones by `canonTombs` (a tomb of something alive is dropped; tombs older than 30 days are pruned against the NEWEST stamp in the data, never the device clock), and the untouched seed notebook is left out.
- **Seed notebook (NO-1):** id `nb-default`, `mtime` 0, created locally whenever no notebook exists; not part of the slice until it holds a page or a label or is renamed.
- **Saving:** typing updates the state at once and saves after 500 ms; `beforeunload` and `visibilitychange:hidden` flush (verified: text typed just before returning to the desktop is stored). `markDirty` once per settled burst.
- **Editor refresh (NO-4):** when the data of the open page changes underneath (a pull), title and text fields are updated even while focused, caret and scroll kept (`syncField`).
- Notifications through `orosNotifs` (`transient`; save failure as an inbox item keyed per hour); local toast only as fallback. Dialogs are native `<dialog>` built in JS, centred by one rule in `notes.css`. Export: page `.txt`, notebook(s) `.zip` (store-method writer, no dependency), both through `orosDialog`. There is no import.
- Touch: long-press on a page row opens the page menu; the notebook menu opens from `#btn-nb-menu` (NO-6).
- **Markdown wave (Obsidian/Joplin parity; no schema change, no new synced field):**
  - **Renderer (NO-MD1):** `OrosNotesMd.render(text, { wiki })` returns an HTML string in which every character of the text is escaped and only allow-listed tags are built (h1–h6, p, br, strong, em, del, code, pre, blockquote, ul/ol (+ numeric `start`), li, `input[type=checkbox][data-line]`, table/thead/tbody/tr/th/td (+ `al-l|c|r` class), hr, a, span, div). Links only `http:`, `https:`, `mailto:` (`safeUrl`: no whitespace, quotes, `<>` or control characters), always `target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`; anything else keeps its label as text. Raw HTML and images are never built (shown as text / a link). Wiki links become `<a class="md-wiki ok|amb|new" data-wiki>` opened by the app. Hard line breaks inside paragraphs (Obsidian default). Not supported: setext headings, footnotes, HTML, images, reference links.
  - **Views:** `prefs.view` edit | preview | split (device-local); split needs `(min-width: 900px)` and reads as edit below it. Preview renders on page change, on sync refresh and (split) 150 ms after typing. A checkbox in preview flips `[ ]`/`[x]` on its source line (`toggleTask`, line index carried in `data-line`), then `touchContent` + the usual debounced save. Toolbar (`format`: bold, italic, heading cycle # → ## → ### → none, list, task, link, code / fenced block) goes through `execCommand("insertText")` so the browser's Undo works; fallback sets the value and fires `input`. Ctrl/Cmd+B, Ctrl/Cmd+I.
  - **Links across notebooks (NO-MD2):** `[[Page]]` → same notebook first (first in data order), else the ONE page of that title elsewhere, several → ambiguous (search opens with All notebooks), none → missing (click creates a sub-page of the current page). `[[Notebook/Page]]` → when the text before the first `/` names exactly one notebook, Page in it (missing → created at the top of that notebook); otherwise, or when that finds nothing, the whole text is a plain title. `[[Target|label]]`. Case and surrounding spaces ignored. Backlinks = pages of any notebook whose links resolve to this page (prefiltered by `[[` + title substring). The link strip is debounced 300 ms while typing.
  - **Daily note:** the calendar button in the editor header opens the child titled `yyyy-mm-dd` (local date) of the top-level page titled Daily / Ημερήσιες (either name, case-insensitive) of the current notebook, creating both when missing with FIXED ids `dly-<nbId>` and `dly-<nbId>-<yyyymmdd>` (a random id only if that id is taken by a renamed page), so two devices that create the same day before syncing make one page (different template times → the usual NO-3 conflict copy). Text from the template titled Daily / Ημερήσιες under Templates, else the built-in `daily.tpl`.
  - **Templates:** every page under a top-level page titled Templates / Πρότυπα in ANY notebook (current notebook first). Footer button + page menu `New page from template…` → pick → title prompt (suggested: the template title filled) → new top-level page in the current notebook. Placeholders `{{date}}` (yyyy-mm-dd), `{{time}}` (HH:MM), `{{title}}`; unknown `{{…}}` stay.
  - **Search:** `All notebooks` checkbox in the overlay (session-only, shown with ≥ 2 notebooks); hits show their notebook and open through `revealPage` (switches notebook, unfolds ancestors).
  - **Export:** page `.md` (`pageMarkdown`: `# Title`, the text, blank line, `---`, the orOS line), notebook(s) `.zip` of `.md` files (same folder layout as `.txt`, file `notes-<date>-md.zip`). The footer export button always opens a menu (current / all × txt / md, plus the open page). The page menu's `Export notebook` now exports the CURRENT notebook (it exported all of them).
- Debug handle `window.__notesDebug` = `{ version, state, merge, canon, sliceGet }`.

### Files app (`files/`) [verified 2026-10-06, `?v=0.39.07`]

- `files/index.html` (toolbar, tree, list, status bar, name and delete dialogs), `files/files.js` (about 4,500 lines since wave 3, one IIFE, ES5), `files/files.css`. Search bar, import button, "More" button, column headers, storage bar, recents, context menu, preview overlay and the sync pill are built by JS.
- All disk access goes through `window.parent.orosFS`. Device-local keys: `oros-files-data` (view prefs; since wave 3 also `layout` "list"|"grid" and `contents` for content search), `oros-files-recents` (journal of 30, `{ p, at }`), `oros-files-storage-cache`, `oros-files-trash-swept` (time of the last 30-day sweep), `oros-files-disk-meta` (`{ ts, dirty }`). Synced: `oros-files-favs` (slice `files`, wave 3).
- **How the disk syncs (FILES-V, 2026-10-06): per file, through Vault Drive.** The app reports nothing. `fs.js` tells `vault.js` about every mutation of the disk (`notifyVault`: a write → `fileChanged(path)`; a delete or a move → `touchTree(path)`), whoever made it; the vault uploads, downloads, deletes and resolves conflicts in the shell, with the Files app open or closed.
  - The app only SHOWS it: the pill reads `orosVault.status()` (off / pending / synced) and a listener (`onStatus`, unsubscribed on `pagehide`) refreshes the list when the vault changed the disk, never under an open editor.
  - Same file changed on two devices: both versions are kept, the cloud's one as `name (conflict YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS).ext`; toast `sync.conflictKept`.
  - The old blob model is gone: no `orosFilesDisk` bridge, no `oros-files-disk-cache` / `-pending` / `-meta`, no conflict dialog, no `files-disk` slice (retired in `sync.js`, SY-R).
- Preview / Quick Edit: text ≤512 KB, images ≤10 MB; Markdown preview makes only `http`, `https`, `mailto` and relative links clickable; Quick Edit decodes strictly (a file that is not UTF-8 is not editable), keeps a BOM, and warns before discarding unsaved text.
- Touch: first tap selects, a second tap on the same row opens it; "More" opens the actions menu (the context menu has no touch equivalent on iOS). Since wave 3 a long press (500 ms, 10 px slop, the next click swallowed; a touch `contextmenu` is ignored) or the header check box opens Select mode.
- `files.css`: no `margin` reset (dialogs are centred by the browser); ends with the `[hidden]` guard; 44 px targets under `(pointer: coarse)`.
- **Wave 3 (Explorer / Nautilus / Google Files parity).** Pure logic in `files/files-core.js` (`OrosFilesCore`, tested in `tests/files-core.test.js`); `files/index.html` also loads `../atelier/zip.js` (reader). Session-only `view` = `files` | `recent` | `trash` (body classes `v-recent`, `v-trash`); rows of those views carry their own `path` (`entryPath(e)`).
  - **Trash (FILES-T).** Files' own Delete (button, key, menu, Select bar, drop on the Trash node) = `moveToTrash`: write `/internal/.trash/<id>.json` `{ v:1, path, name, dir, at }` FIRST, then `orosFS.mv(item, /internal/.trash/<id>/<name>)`; a failed move takes the record back. `<id>` = deletion ms in base 36 (9 digits) + `-` + random, so a folder whose record has not arrived still has an age. One record per item, never a shared index file: two devices trashing at once would turn one index into a Vault conflict copy. Shift+Delete and everything inside the Trash delete for good (`orosFS.rm`). Other apps' `orosFS.rm` is untouched (no trash). Restore: `mkdir` of the old parent (falls back to the root), free name (`uniqueName`), `mv` back, then remove the record (`trashDiscard`). A trashed empty folder reaches other devices only as its record (empty folders don't sync): Restore makes it again with `mkdir`. A file whose record arrived before its content shows faded and refuses Restore ("not on this device yet"). Sweep (`trashSweepLoad`): at boot every 12 h (4 s after boot) and whenever the Trash view opens, records older than 30 days and leftover id folders with neither item nor record (what a remote restore leaves behind) are removed. Empty Trash = `orosFS.rm("/internal/.trash")`. Sync: these are plain moves/writes/removals, so Vault Drive carries them (verified two-context: trash on A → the file leaves its folder on B and B's Trash shows it; restore on B → back on A, A's Trash empty).
  - The `.trash` folder is hidden from every Files view, the folder tree, the Move/Copy chooser, Files' search and the universal search provider (`files/search.js` 1.0.1); the name `.trash` is refused at the root (`err.reserved`) and an import of that name becomes `_trash`. Deep links into it open the Trash view. The storage figure still counts it.
  - **Favourites (slice `files`, key `oros-files-favs`).** `{ v:1, items:[{ p, dir, m, del? }] }` sorted by `p`; per item bigger `m` wins, a tie goes to the removal, then the larger JSON (R5, R17, R26); at most 300 tombstones kept (newest). Stamped only at the mutation site (`favCommit` compares JSON first, R27); the setter never marks dirty (R6). A rename/move in Files carries favourites (`favMove`), trashing drops them (`favDrop`). Shown under "Recent" at the top of the tree with an unpin star; a missing path is faded (not pruned: it may still be syncing). Verified two-context: pin on A shows on B, unpin on B converges, idle syncs stay clean.
  - **Recent.** Device-local journal of 30 (was 10); the main folder still shows 10, the Recent view all of them with the folder and age; renames and moves inside Files rewrite journal paths (`recentsMove`).
  - **Search.** Names (folded: case, accents, final sigma; `fold()` keeps string length so snippet indexes map to the original) everywhere under the open folder, then, with `Contents` on, text files ≤ 4 MB (`contentKind`: txt, md, csv, json, html stripped of tags, code, …, no extension; a NUL in the first 4 KB = binary, skipped) and PDFs ≤ 30 MB (PDF.js `getTextContent`, first 300 pages, stops at the first matching page). Progress line, skipped count, no cap: 100 shown, "Show more" adds 100. A new query or `refresh()` restarts it (`renderToken`).
  - **ZIP.** Writer `zipBuild` in files-core.js (UTF-8 flag, method 0 or 8, no ZIP64: Error `zip-big` past 65535 entries / 4 GB), deflate through `CompressionStream("deflate-raw")` when present and smaller, already-compressed kinds stored (`shouldStore`). Caps: 10,000 files / 300 MB per new ZIP. Reader = `AtelierZip.open` (whole file in memory, ≤ 300 MB here; 20,000 entries; 80 MB per entry). `extractPlan`: `..`/absolute/drive paths dropped (no escape), bad characters → `_`, `__MACOSX` and `.DS_Store` skipped, clashes and file-vs-folder collisions get " (1)", 1 GB total cap; a single common top folder becomes the target folder itself (no `Docs/Docs`). Extraction never overwrites (new folder, free name). The .zip preview lists up to 500 entries.
  - **Grid view** (`#entries.grid`, per device). Thumbnails for images and the first PDF page (≤ 20 MB), made lazily (IntersectionObserver, 2 at a time) on a 192 px canvas → WebP object URL, memory cache of 150 keyed by path + mtime + size, never stored.
  - **Select mode** (`body.select-mode`): check boxes replace icons, bottom `#sel-bar` (Done, count, Select all, Restore in the Trash, Favourite for one item, ZIP, Move, Copy, Delete). Esc leaves it.
- **The whole Dropbox (since the Files Dropbox wave 1).** `files/dropbox-core.js` (`OrosDropboxCore`, pure, tested in `tests/files-dropbox.test.js`) + `files/dropbox.js` (`OrosFilesDropbox`) + `files/dropbox-callback.html/.js`. A "Dropbox" node under the disk in the tree switches the app to `body.dbx-mode`: the disk toolbar, list and status are hidden, `#dbx-bar` (up, crumbs, refresh, account) and `#dbx-panel` (search, list, status) are shown; `navigate()` leaves it. Read only in wave 1: browse (`files/list_folder`, 2000 per page, 50 pages), search names (`files/search_v2`, 100), preview (text ≤512 KB UTF-8 as text, images ≤10 MB) and download (through `orosDialog.saveFile`).
  - **A second Dropbox app, not sync's.** Sync's app (`sync.js`, App folder) is untouched. This view needs a Dropbox app with **Full Dropbox** access (a Dropbox app's access type cannot change after creation): `OrosDropboxCore.APP_KEY` (`fv6idclg1tn5hq8`, Chris's "orOS Files" app, set 2026-10-14) or the user's own key (device-local `oros-files-dbx-key`, `[a-z0-9]{8,32}`). Scopes on the Dropbox app: `files.metadata.read`, `files.content.read`, `files.content.write` (the last for wave 2 moves). Redirect URI `https://useoros.online/files/dropbox-callback.html`.
  - **Sign-in:** OAuth 2.0 + PKCE as a public client with `token_access_type=offline`, popup first, whole-tab redirect when blocked (back to `/?open=files`), state checked against `oros-files-dbx-pkce`; the same pattern as Chess › Lichess. The token record `{ access, refresh, exp, key, who }` is sealed with a non-extractable AES-GCM key in IndexedDB `oros-files-dbx` (in the factory-reset list), never in localStorage, never synced. An expired access token is refreshed once (single flight); a refused refresh drops the record. Disconnect revokes the token (`auth/token/revoke`).
  - **Sync folder guard:** a folder whose listing holds `orOS-data.json` (or `vault` + an `orOS-backup-*.json`) is sync's own encrypted folder; its lower-case path goes to device-local `oros-files-dbx-sync`, the folder shows a lock and a notice instead of its contents, and search results inside it are dropped.
  - Every Dropbox name is shown with `textContent`; `Dropbox-API-Arg` escapes every character from U+007F (Greek names). Browsing never touches the disk, the vault or a sync slice. Device-local `oros-files-dbx-view` `{ on, path }` reopens the last place.
  - **Copy / Move into the disk (wave 2, 1.97.00).** Rows have checkboxes (header: all shown); a selection bar and the preview offer `Copy to orOS disk` / `Move to orOS disk`; the destination comes from Files' own folder chooser (`pickFolderDialog`, shared with Move/Copy). `planItems` expands selected folders (`list_folder` recursive), makes each name disk-safe (`localName`), skips sync's folder, non-downloadable files, files over 300 MB and anything past 1000 files / 1 GB. Each file: download → Dropbox `content_hash` check (a damaged download never lands) → SHA-256 → write through `orosFS` under a free name (`uniqueName`, never over a file). The disk write reaches the vault through fs.js as always.
  - **Move deletes only confirmed copies:** after the copies, the view runs `orosVault.sync` until nothing of the job is queued (5 min cap), then for each file `confirmedCopy(item, orosVault.manifestEntry(dst), orosVault.isQueued(dst))` must hold (synced manifest has the destination with the same SHA-256) before `files/delete_v2` with `parent_rev` = the copied rev (a file changed meanwhile stays). Deleted files go to Dropbox's deleted files (30 days). A selected folder is deleted only when every file of it was deleted and a fresh recursive listing finds no file left. Moving is refused unless `orosVault.status().usable`.
  - **Job journal:** device-local `oros-files-dbx-job` `{ mode, dest, folders, items: [{ src, rev, hash, size, rel, dst, h, st }] }`, saved before every write (the destination name is fixed first, so a resume finds its own file by SHA-256 and never duplicates). An interrupted job is offered as `Continue` / `Discard` when the view opens; `Stop` ends a job without removing any original. Resuming a move without usable sync turns it into a copy and keeps every original.

### Help app (`help/`) [verified 2026-10-09, `?v=0.48.00`]
- **What:** the orOS guide (EN/EL, offline, searchable). Category System. No sync slice, no stored state.
- **Pages:** plain-text files in a strict Markdown subset, NOT `.md` (GitHub Pages runs Jekyll and would turn `.md` into HTML): topics in `help/topics/<id>.<lang>.txt` (order in `help/topics.json`), one page per app in `<appId>/help.<lang>.txt`. App list comes from `apps.json` (menu grouping). Missing page → "soon" tag; missing EL → EN with a note.
- **Format:** `# Title` (once) · `##`/`###` (anchor = folded slug of the text) · paragraphs · `-` / `1.` lists (one level, two-space continuation) · `> tip` · `>! warning` · `**bold**` · `` `UI label` `` · `[[Ctrl+Alt+Shift+H]]` key chips · `[text](app:<id> | help:a/<id>[#slug] | help:t/<id>[#slug] | https://…)`. No HTML, images, tables. Rendered with `textContent` only. App outline: intro · Getting started · task sections · Sync and backup · Keyboard shortcuts (if any) · Tips · Limits (if any); EN and EL keep the same ##/### outline. Write from the code; exact UI labels in backticks.
- **Routes:** `#t/<id>`, `#a/<id>`, optional `/<slug>`; `location.replace` only (no history entries). Fetches carry `?v=` of `help.js` so a release never serves the previous release's page (SW `releaseCopy`).
- **Shell (`shell.js`):** `openHelp(route)` (default: the running app's page), taskbar `#help-btn` (shown only when `apps.json` lists `help`; ≤480 px: hidden on the desktop, replaces `#btn-lang` while an app runs; `body.app-running` set by `openApp`/`returnToDesktop`), `SC_DEFS` H, `window.orosHelp = { open(route), openApp(id) }`. Strings `bar.help`, `sc.desc.help`.
- **Search:** in-memory index of every page in the current language, built in the background; accent-, case- and final-sigma-insensitive (`fold`); every term must match; title 12 / heading 5 / text 1.
- **Precache:** `help/` files, every topic and every registered app's `help.*.txt` (the app's release commit adds its two lines; `tests/help.test.js` fails otherwise once Help is precached).

### Settings app (`settings/`) [verified 2026-10-10, `?v=0.50.00`]
- **What:** "Settings" / "Ρυθμίσεις", category System. The settings of orOS itself, moved out of the menu (Chris 2026-10-09). Sections: Appearance (theme, skin, wallpaper, Dock, screen pet) · Notifications · Sync · Backups · Language & search · System (version, updates, install, links, shortcuts, factory reset). Wide: sidebar + page; < 720 px: list → page with Back and Esc.
- **Storage:** none. The app never writes storage; it reads a snapshot and calls `parent.orosSettings` (`set`, `act`), notifications through `parent.orosNotifs`. No sync slice, nothing to migrate. Each card shows its scope ("All devices" / "This device") from `core.js` `SCOPE`.
- **Shell:** `window.orosSettings` (bridge table above); `settingsNotify()` batched, called at the end of `renderMenu` and on auto-sync events. `open(section)` uses `__orosOpenAt("settings", { section })`.
- **Ways in:** menu row "Settings" (above Device info and Info) · System category · sync dot when sync is off or locked → Sync · Info window button `sc.reset.moved` → System · Device info sync card → Sync · universal search (`settings/search.js`, section topics).
- **Menu section** (since launcher 1.3.0): `menu` sits between Appearance and Notifications. Snapshot `menu: [{ id, name, cat, catName, shown }]` (null when the launcher lacks `menuHidden`/`setMenuHidden`); `set("menu:<id>", shown)` (ids checked against the internal apps), `act("menu.showAll")`, `act("menu.hideAll")` → `orosLauncher.setMenuHidden`. The list is grouped by category, with a find field (memory only) and an "n of total shown" line. Scope "All devices".
- **Rule:** new shell settings go into Settings, never back into the menu.

### Rules for every app

- **CSS:** `[hidden]{display:none!important}` is the LAST rule of every app stylesheet. Per-element display rules are guarded with `:not([hidden])`. Shell CSS variables are the only styling truth (`inheritPalette` + `watchPalette`, G3). `LABEL_PALETTE` is data, not skin.
- **i18n:** EN/EL only, EN default. Locales el-GR / en-GB. Greek dates: dd/mm/yyyy, no comma after the day.
- **Data:** additive-only migrations; idempotent normalize on load AND on merge results; rescue backup before any reseed; the device-local whitelist is never synced.
- **File I/O:** R33. **Popups:** R32. **Cloud:** R34.

---

### `launcher.js` (Favourites: desktop shortcuts + Dock, shell component) [verified 0.49.00]

- Loads after `wallpaper/art.js`, before `shell.js`; touches nothing at parse time. `shell.js` calls `orosLauncher.attach({ apps, open, running, label, icons, lang, desktop })` right after `initPrefs()`, `refresh()` at the end of `renderMenu`, `menuRow(btn, app)` for every app row of the menu and, since 0.50.00, `renderSettings(menu)` ONLY when the launcher has no `setPref` (old bundle); otherwise the Dock settings live in Settings › Appearance through `orosSettings.set("dock:<k>")` → `setPref`. Every call is guarded: a bundle without the file draws what it drew before.
- **Menu:** a star (44×44) at the end of every app row. It opens a panel IN PLACE (no menu rebuild; the open panel survives rebuilds, memory only) with two switches, "On the desktop" and "In the Dock"; when the app is in the Dock and the Dock is off, a line says so with "Turn on". Filled star = the app has a shortcut anywhere.
- **Desktop:** `#ld-desk` inside `#oros-desktop`, an automatic grid in the order added (no free placement: it would differ per screen). Tap opens; right-click, long press (500 ms, 10 px slop, the following click swallowed) or the context-menu key opens a small menu: Open · Move earlier · Move later · Remove from desktop. Arrow keys walk that menu, Escape returns focus to the icon. Long names hyphenate (`lang` on the grid).
- **Dock:** `#ld-dock` (z-index 950: over a running app at 900, under the menu at 999), centred at the bottom, OFF by default. Menu section "Dock" (`#ld-set`, rebuilt in place, focus kept): Show the Dock · Size (small 40 / medium 52 / large 64 px) · Magnify on hover (mouse only, shown only for a fine pointer) · Hide automatically · Show over open apps (off until the user turns it on, on every device; since launcher 1.1.0, before that it followed the pointer). Style (launcher 1.1.0, Settings only): Classic (the original translucent bar, default) · Glass · Frosted · Smoke · Transparent · Solid · 3D shelf · Neon; one `ld-s-<style>` class on `#ld-dock`, skin variables where it can. Hover effect (launcher 1.2.0, mouse only, Settings select replacing the Magnify switch): Magnify (default) · Bounce · Pulse · Frame · Glow · Lift · Wiggle · None; one `ld-h-<effect>` class on `#ld-dock`, effects on `.ld-tile` only; reduced motion turns Bounce / Pulse / Wiggle into the frame. Magnify grows icons from layout positions (`offsetLeft`, never the transformed boxes), slides neighbours apart by the extra width and widens the bar equally on both sides (`--ld-mag`), so icons never overlap and resting centres never move. A dot marks the open app (`aria-current`); tapping the open app never reloads it. Mouse users drag to reorder; touch uses the long-press menu (a finger drag scrolls the Dock: one row, sideways scroll at ≤ 480 px). Auto-hide: a 10 px edge strip (mouse) or a small handle (touch, `#ld-edge`) shows it; leaving or tapping elsewhere hides it; keyboard focus shows it.
- While the Dock is shown and not auto-hidden it sets `--tb-h` on `<html>`: the pet layer (`pet.css`, the old hook) and the desktop grid rise above it; with "over open apps", `html.ld-push` ends `#oros-running` above the Dock. Without "over open apps" a CSS sibling rule hides the Dock while an app runs.
- Styles are injected once (`#ld-css`) and use only skin variables.
- **Menu apps (1.3.0):** `menuHidden(id)`, `menuHiddenIds()`, `setMenuHidden(ids, hidden)`; host option `menuChanged()` (shell passes `renderMenu`) runs after a user change or a pull that changed the list. Schema MENU APPS v1 (Part IV). In `renderAppList` a hidden app is skipped unless a query is typed; category counts count shown apps; with apps hidden a row "n hidden apps · Choose apps" (`.menu-hidden-row`) opens Settings › Menu; with every app hidden the list says so.

### Sticky Notes (`stickies/`, shell side `stickies/host.js`) [1.02.00]
- `stickies/core.js` (UMD `StickiesCore`, pure) + `stickies/host.js` load in `index.html` right after `today/host.js` (so after `notifications.js`). Inert until `apps.json` lists `stickies` (`orosStickiesEnv.registered()`).
- The host is the ONLY writer of `oros-stickies-data` (slice `stickies`, registered by the host with no storage key, merge `StickiesCore.merge`). The app (`stickies/stickies.js`) only reads and asks through `window.parent.orosStickies` (`data`, `prefs`, `setPref`, `newNote`, `create`, `edit`, `show`, `remove` (Undo toast), `restore`, `fade`, `tidy`, `testSound`, `exportText`, `onChange`).
- Desktop: `#sn-layer` (fixed, inside `#oros-desktop`, z-index 2 in the desktop's stacking context, so a running app hides it and the pet stays in front) with free notes on screens ≥ 600 px; `#sn-strip` (first child of `#oros-desktop`, a row of cards above the launcher grid) under 600 px; `#sn-add` round "+" bottom-left above `--tb-h`. Right-click / long press on an empty desktop spot: New sticky note · Tidy up · Open the app.
- Editor: one centred `<dialog id="sn-sheet">` in the shell document (also over the app): text, colour, Ring (quick picks + datetime-local), Vanish (quick picks + datetime-local + "also when the ring is Done"), Delete, Done.
- Engine: `orosStickies.tick()` every second from the shell clock (`stickiesTick`, inside the engines-may-run block). Rings: wiggle + chime (Web Audio, three presets, notification volume, off in quiet hours / with notifications or the Sticky Notes toggle off) + `orosNotifs.emit` (`ns:"stickies"`, key `ring-<id>-<at>`, deep link `stickies:<id>` → `__orosOpenStickies`). A ring found more than 2 min late is announced without sound. Fades at `vanish.at` and empties the Faded bin after 7 days with stamps computed from the data (identical bytes on every device).
- Shortcut Ctrl+Alt+Shift+N (`scNewSticky`).
- Phase 2 [1.12.00]: `ring` may be `{ at, rep, t }` (rep "daily" | "weekdays" | "weekly", t = the planned moment of this round; Snooze moves `at` only; Done moves both to `nextRound(rep, t, max(now, t))`, local clock time kept, and never fades the note). A ring without a repeat keeps the v1 bytes `{ at }`. Editor: Repeat select under the ring time; Send to To-Do (BR-TD-ADD: open `[ ]` lines → tasks, else one task = first line + rest as note) and Copy to Notes (`__orosOpenAt("notes", { add: { title, text } })`), shown only for installed apps (`orosAssistInstalled`), prefill only. Ring sound pref may be `"rt:<melody id>"`: the host reads `oros-ringtones-data` (never writes it), loads `ringtones/core.js` on first need, plays `renderSamples` (≤ 15 s, notification volume); a deleted melody plays the bell. Universal search provider `stickies/search.js` (notes on the desktop; target `{ note }`, opens through `__orosOpenStickies`); Today provider `stickies/today.js` (one task row per open ring, late ones Overdue, repeating rings up to the horizon, max 8 rounds).

### Meal Planner pantry engine + bridge (`meals/`, wave 3)
- `mealsCheckTick` (shell, 60 s throttle): reads `oros-meals-data` with the app closed and asks `OrosMealsPantry.expiryNotice(raw, today)` (`meals/pantry.js`, loaded by index.html, the same file the app runs; it needs no core.js: it validates ids, takes the newest copy per id and honours tombs itself) which pantry items reach their best-before day today or tomorrow. Off unless `oros-meals-prefs.nt` is an hour 0–23 (device-local, default -1); from that hour on, one notice per day per set of items: key `bb-<today>-<djb2 of id:d list>`, body "Best before today: … · Best before tomorrow: …" (3 names + "and N more"), deepLink `meals:pantry` → `__orosOpenAt("meals", { pantry: true })` (Pantry tab). `meals` joined `KNOWN_APPS`. Nothing due = silent (SH-B7).
- `budgetCheckTick` (shell, 60 s throttle): reads `oros-budget-data` with the app closed and asks `OrosBudgetPlan.subsDue(raw, today)` (`budget/plan.js`, loaded by index.html, the same file the app runs) which recurring expenses with a reminder lead `nd` charge within it. From the device-local hour `oros-budget-prefs.nh` (default 9, -1 = off on this device); one notice per charge, key `sub-<recId>-<yyyymmdd>`, body "Netflix: 12,99 € tomorrow", deepLink `budget:sub:<recId>` → `__orosOpenAt("budget", { sub })` (Recurring › Subscriptions with the entry open). `budget` already in `KNOWN_APPS`. No reminders set = silent (SH-B7).

### Stock engine + bridges (`stock/`, 1.04.00)
- `stockCheckTick` (shell, 60 s throttle): reads `oros-stock-data` with the app closed, `OrosStockCore.lowList` + `toNotify`: a product is announced once when it ENTERS the low list and again only after it left it (device-local `oros-stock-notified`). At most one grouped notification per tick (3 names + "and N more"), key `low-<today>-<djb2>`, deepLink `stock:<itemId>` (one product) or `stock:reorder`. Switch `oros-stock-prefs.notify`; while off the map still follows the list (no replay when switched on). No products = silent (SH-B7).
- Today provider `stock/today.js` (apps.json `"today": "today.js"`, uses the shell's OrosStockCore): an info line "To reorder: N" while products are low (`{view: "reorder"}`), and open purchase orders whose expected day is past or within the horizon as tasks on that day (`{po}`; late ones land in Overdue). No `open()`: Today falls back to `__orosOpenAt("stock", target)`.
- Stock's receiver also takes `{po: id}` (order sheet) and `{view: "reports"}`.
- Outgoing bridges (all prefills, nothing written elsewhere until saved there): To-Do BR-TD-ADD (a Reorder supplier group or an order: `newList` "Order · <supplier>", items "8 pcs × Name (supplier code)"); Mail compose (to = supplier e-mail, shown only when Mail has an account on the device); Budget BR-B1 from a receipt (`k:"o"`, `c:"o-other"`) or a sale (`k:"i"`, `c:"i-other"`), amount = the movement total, `src:"stock"`; Quote BR-Q1 from a product sheet or "Quote from products" (any ISO currency since wave 46; before, EUR/USD only); Spreadsheet BR-S1 from Reports (one row per product, sums on value and sales, at most 499 rows).
- **Counter** (`New` › `Counter (quick sale)`): scan / search adds one unit per scan, − / + per line, total at sale prices; `Complete sale` writes ONE `out` movement (ref "Counter" / «Ταμείο», `p` = the product's sale price when set) after the usual below-zero check (confirm, or refused when `settings.neg = 0`); Undo in the toast voids it. The open sale is page memory only (kept while the counter is closed and reopened; lost on reload); nothing is written before Complete.
- **Barcode labels** (`New` › `Barcode labels`, product sheet): line picker (copies + price on the label), A4 sheet 3 × 8 of 70 × 37 mm, at most 240 labels; printed from a hidden `srcdoc` frame (`#st-print`, all text escaped). Products without barcode or SKU are named and skipped.
- Toasts: a closing dialog hands the toast to the dialog still open under it (fix: Undo after a confirm over the counter was unreachable).
- **Camera scanning:** a 📷 button next to the product search, the movement editor's finder and the counter, shown only where `BarcodeDetector` and `getUserMedia` exist (Chrome on Android); elsewhere hidden, a scanner that types still works. A read code goes into the field followed by a synthetic Enter, so each field keeps its own rules. Search: one code, then the camera closes. Editor / counter: stays open; the same code counts again only after it left the picture (≥ 1.2 s). Tracks stop when the dialog closes. Nothing leaves the device.
- **Warehouses** (Settings › Warehouses): the main one can only be renamed; another one is deleted while unused, else archived (confirm if it still holds stock). With at least one active extra warehouse: a Warehouse select in the movement editor (From / To for a transfer, same pair refused), the counter, receipts from purchase orders and BR-ST-OUT; New › Transfer; a Products filter by warehouse (quantity, "out of stock" and qty sort per warehouse; minimums and Reorder stay business-wide); "By warehouse" in the product sheet; stock count and the below-zero check use the chosen warehouse's quantity; Reports adds Value per warehouse; Movements CSV gets Warehouse + To warehouse columns.
- **Lots:** receipt / customer-return lines get Lot + Expires behind "+ Lot / expiry" (open by themselves once the product has lots; an expiry alone becomes the lot name; known lots suggested). Sale / return to supplier / loss lines of a product with lots left get a Lot select, default "First to expire". The counter always takes the first to expire. Product sheet: Lots (expired red, ≤ 30 days amber, "Without a lot"). Products chip "Expiring" (≤ 30 days, only when such lots exist). Reports: "Expiring within 30 days". Movements CSV gets Lot + Expiry columns when any lot exists.
- **Today (stock/today.js 1.1):** lots expiring within 7 days as tasks on their expiry day (expired → Overdue), target {item}.
- **Close a period** (Settings): default 31 Dec of last year (or yesterday after a later close); must be before today and after the current close; says how many movements go; confirm; archive file, then close. Movement dates inside the closed period are refused (editor min date; BR-ST-OUT falls back to today). Movements list shows the Opening balance row (sheet with warehouse / lot per line, no Void). **Reopen** (same dialog, on a device that has the archive file): tombstone on the close, then the archive merges back. The dialog shows the size of the Stock data on this device.
- Two-device E2E: an offline sale dated inside the period, synced after the close, stays and counts on top of the opening; the other device's old copies drop; reopen restores all on both.
- `keepCheckTickThrottled` (shell, 60 s, Contacts wave 26): reads `oros-contacts-data` with the app closed (`OrosContactsKeep` from `contacts/keep.js`, loaded by `index.html`) and the device-local switch `oros-contacts-keep` (default off, hour 10); one notice per day (ns contacts, key `keep-<ymd>`) once the hour has come and someone is overdue; deep link `contacts:<id>` or `contacts:@reachout`.
- `crmCheckTickThrottled` (shell, 60 s, CRM v1.1.0 at 1.14.00): reads `oros-crm-data` with the app closed (`OrosCrmCore` from `crm/core.js`, loaded by `index.html`) and device-local `oros-crm-notified`; notice ns crm, key `fup-<id>|<day><time>` per open follow-up once due (earlier days; today untimed; today at or after its time), at most 10 per tick, nothing marked before the inbox is ready; deep link `crm:<followUpId>`; not absorbed by Today (per item, like Health doses). The app's own reminder loop is gone.
- DL_BRIDGES `stock:` → `__orosOpenAt("stock", {view: "reorder"} | {item: id})`. Stock's single receiver (`window.__orosOpenAt` + boot `__orosTakeTarget("stock")`) takes `{item}`, `{sup}` (universal search) and `{view: "reorder"}`; ignored while a dialog is open.
- Universal search: `stock/search.js` (products: name; SKU, barcode, category, location, supplier, supplier code, note; suppliers: name; person, phone, e-mail, VAT no.). Archived products and tombstoned rows skipped (an item with movements never counts as deleted).
- Outgoing: Label Maker `__orosOpenAt("labels", {text: name · SKU})` from the product sheet. Contacts read-only (`oros-contacts-data`) for "From Contacts" in a new supplier (copy, nothing written back).

### Connected services (`links/`, integrations wave 1)
- **What.** One owner in the shell for every account orOS keeps with another platform (plan /mnt/project-files/integrations/integrations-plan.md). Wave 1 = WooCommerce (Stock). No app asks for, stores or sends keys itself; apps call `parent.orosLinks`.
- **Files.** `links/core.js` (`OrosLinksCore`, pure, Node-testable: PLATFORMS, normSite/normAcct, merge, checkKeys, checkReq allowlist, extId), `links/host.js` (`window.orosLinks`, shell; index.html loads core.js + host.js after stickies/host.js), `links/woo.js` (`OrosLinksWoo`, WooCommerce mapping: productPlan, compare, stockReq, normOrder, outRequest, invoicePrefill, budgetPrefill, crmLog), `stock/shop.js` (Stock's shop panel), `relay/ext.js` (relay op `ext`), since 1.58.00 `links/mydata.js` + `invoices/mydata-ui.js` (myDATA). Tests `tests/links.test.js` (one case list run against both checkReq and the relay's checkExtReq), `tests/mydata.test.js`.
- **Slice `links`** (key `oros-links-data`, registered by the shell): `{accts: [{id, m, p, name, site, ks, s?, sm?, d?}]}`. LWW per id by `m` (tie: tombstone, then larger canonical JSON); a tombstone keeps only `{id, m, p, d:1}`. No keys in clear, ever.
- **Keys.** IndexedDB `oros-links` (stores `keys`: non-extractable AES-GCM key; `creds`: id → `{iv, data, m}`), device only, never synced or exported, in the factory-reset list. Opt-in per account (`ks: 1`, "Use on all my devices"): the keys also travel as `s` sealed with `orosSync.vaultCrypto` (sync passphrase), only while sync is connected and unlocked; resealed only when the local `m` is newer than `sm` or no sealed copy exists (no upload loop). A device without keys takes them from `s`.
- **API (`window.orosLinks`).** `list(p?)`, `get(id)`, `add({p, name, site, keys})`, `edit(id, fields)`, `setKeys(id, keys)`, `hasKeys(id)`, `setKeySync(id, on)`, `canKeySync()`, `remove(id)`, `call(id, reqs ≤ 10)` → `{ok, res:[{status, data|err}]}` or `{ok:false, err}`, `test(id)`, `statusCode`, `mode(id)`, `onChange(fn)`, `platforms`. Error codes only (offline, auth, notfound, keys, relay, network, denied, server, busy, gone, bad), never text from the shop.
- **Call path.** Every request must pass `checkReq` (exact allowlist per platform). WooCommerce: direct with Basic auth; on 401 retry with the keys in the query (hosts that drop the Authorization header); when the browser can't reach the shop, the relay `ext` op. The way that worked is remembered per account in device-local `oros-links-prefs`.
- **Settings › Connected services** (section `services`, before System): add / test / edit / replace keys / key-sync switch / two-tap Disconnect / Open Stock.
- **Stock shop panel** (`__orosOpenAt("stock", {view: "shop"})`, add sheet and Settings › Data): Products (import as Stock items with ids `extId("woo", acct, product)` and one count move, compare, send our stock to the shop or take theirs) and Orders (last 30 days, ≤ 50: record sale through BR-ST-OUT with `src "woo:<acct>-<order>"`, invoice via BR-CRM-INV, CRM log via BR-CRM-MAIL, Budget via BR-B1, mark completed). Every prefill opens unsaved, as the bridges require.
- **timologisi.online (`p: "tol"`, wave 2, 1.58.00).** Greek e-invoicing provider (Novus provider API, `/api/v1/Provider`). Account rows add `env` (`test` → provider-dev.timologisi.online, `live` → provider.timologisi.online; fixed hosts, no site) and `vat` (issuer ΑΦΜ, 9 digits); `normAcct` writes `env`/`vat` only for platforms that have them, so WooCommerce rows keep their bytes. Key `{key}` (header `API-KEY`). Allowlist: GET `/GetCreditsBalance` (the probe and `test()`), GET `/RequestTransmittedDocs` (issuerVatNumber, issuedFrom/To, uid, invoiceMark, series, aa, invoiceType, branch), POST `/SendInvoices` with exactly one invoice (`okInvoice`: known top-level keys, type in TOL_TYPES 1.1–1.3, 2.1–2.3, 5.1, 5.2, 11.1, 11.2, 11.4, issuer ΑΦΜ 9 digits, ≤ 64 KB). An older 1.57 device drops `tol` rows in its own copy; the union restores them on newer devices.
- **Writes that must happen once (`once: true`).** A platform marked `once` never retries or falls back on a write: with no known route the shell first runs the probe GET to learn it; a failed or unanswered write returns `unknown` (not `network`), and the caller must look the document up before sending again. `test()` uses each platform's `probe`.
- **Email platforms (wave 3, 1.59.00).** `mlite` (MailerLite, connect.mailerlite.com/api, Bearer), `mchimp` (Mailchimp, `<dc>.api.mailchimp.com/3.0`, dc = the key's suffix, Basic `oros:key`, `relayOnly`: never asked from the browser), `brevo` (api.brevo.com/v3, header `api-key`). Platform fields `host` / `hostOf(keys)`; `L.apiUrl(p, acct, path, keys)`, `L.authHeader(p, keys)`. One key `{key}` each. Allowlist: groups / audiences / lists, their members (MailerLite `filter[status]` + cursor; Mailchimp `count/offset/status` + a fixed `fields`; Brevo `limit/offset`), and writes: MailerLite `POST /batch` (≤ 50 `POST api/subscribers` upserts; `status` only "unsubscribed", never `resubscribe`), Mailchimp `POST /lists/<id>` (≤ 250 members; "subscribed" only with `update_existing:false`), Brevo `POST /contacts/import` (≤ 250 rows, one list) and `POST /contacts/lists/<id>/contacts/remove` (≤ 150). `links/mail.js` (`OrosLinksMail`, pure): `groupsReq/readGroups`, `membersReq/readMembers` (st on/off/bounce/spam), `plan(local, remote, {pull, push, supp})` → `{offHere, offThere, add, send}`, `pushReqs`, `unsubReqs`, `readWrite`. `newsletter/platforms.js` (`OrosNewsletterPlatforms`): Subscribers › Email platforms (link / Sync / Unlink). Sync order: read everything there → show the plan → Apply: this list first (saved), then unsubscribes there, then additions there. Added people: `src "platform"`, basis consent, tag = the platform's name.
- **CRMs (wave 4, 1.60.00).** `hubspot` (api.hubapi.com, root "", Bearer private-app token `pat-…`, `relayOnly`) and `pdrive` (Pipedrive, api.pipedrive.com/api/v2, header `x-api-token`, 40-hex token), apps ["crm"]. Read-only allowlist: HubSpot `GET /crm/v3/pipelines/deals` and `/crm/v3/objects/{companies,contacts,deals}` (limit ≤ 100, `after`, one fixed `properties` list each, fixed `associations`); Pipedrive v2 `GET /stages`, `/organizations`, `/persons`, `/deals` (`status`), `/activities` (`done`), limit ≤ 500, `cursor` (`%2B`/`%2F`/`%3D` allowed there only; checkReq refuses any other `%`). `links/crm.js` (`OrosLinksCrm`, pure): `KINDS[p]`, `req(p, kind, at)`, `read(p, kind, data)` → `{items, next}`, `plan(C, crm, got, {p, acct, src, now, upd, revive})` → `{cust|deals|fups: {add, upd}, same, here, gone, noCust, otherCur, over}`, `count`. Ids `extId(p, acct, "org"|"person"|"deal"|"act", xid)`. Companies → customers (contacts as `people` lines; a contact without a company → a person customer); a customer already here by name or e-mail is used, never changed (`here`); deals: won/lost kept, open → the built-in stage by probability (≤15 new, ≤35 contact, ≤60 proposal, else nego), a value only in CRM's currency (else 0 + a note on add); Pipedrive open activities → follow-ups (a local `done` is kept). Updates overlay only the platform's fields (cust: name, kind, phone, email, web, addr, country, job, people; deal: cust, title, val, stage, prob, close, cd, why; fup: cust, d, t, text, deal). A tombstoned id is not brought back unless `revive`. `crm/platforms.js` (`OrosCrmPlatforms`): CRM › Settings › Import from HubSpot or Pipedrive (Read → plan → Import; one commit, Undo tombs the added and restores the changed). No new CRM fields.
- **Payments (wave 4B, 1.61.00).** `stripe` (api.stripe.com/v1, Bearer, `relayOnly`, apps ["budget"]): a restricted key only (`rk_(live|test)_…`; `sk_` refused by the key pattern, app and relay). Read-only allowlist: GET `/balance` (probe), GET `/balance_transactions` (limit ≤ 100, `starting_after` txn_…, `created[gte]`/`created[lt]` unix). `links/pay.js` (`OrosLinksPay`, pure): `req(fromSec, after)`, `read(data)` → `{items, next}` (next = last id while `has_more`), `plan({tx, tombs, cur}, items, {acct, src, feeNote, catIn, catOut, ac})` → `{add, same, gone, otherCur, skip}`. charge/payment → income (gross, id `extId("stripe", acct, "txn", txn)`) + its fee → expense (`"fee"`); refund/payment_refund/stripe_fee → expense; adjustment/dispute by sign; payout/transfer/topup/reserve etc. skipped; other currencies than Budget's skipped; zero-decimal currencies (JPY …) × 100; a `tx:<id>` tomb is not brought back. `budget/payments.js` (`OrosBudgetPay`): More › Import from Stripe (account, from date, income/expense category, Budget account) → Read → Import (one commit; Undo tombstones the added). No new Budget fields.
- **Invoice Ninja (wave 4C, 1.62.00).** `ininja` (`site: true`: the person's own install or invoicing.co, address normalised like WooCommerce's, a trailing `/api/v1` stripped; root `/api/v1`; header `X-API-TOKEN`, 32–128 letters/digits; extra header `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest` via `L.extraHeaders(p)`), apps ["crm", "budget"]; direct first, the relay when the browser can't reach it (site platforms send `host`/`base`/`key`). Read-only allowlist: GET `/statics`, `/clients` (`per_page` ≤ 100, `page`, `status=active`), `/payments` (`per_page`, `page`). CRM: `links/crm.js` KINDS.ininja ["orgs"]; a client → a customer with its contacts as `people`, `afm` from `vat_number` (EL prefix and spaces dropped), matched first by ΑΦΜ, then name/e-mail; `afm` is in the overlay fields for ininja only. Budget: `links/pay.js` `inReq(kind, page)`, `inCurrencies(statics)` (currency id → code), `inRead(data, curMap, fromYmd)` → payments with status completed / partly or fully refunded / unapplied, net of `refunded`, as income (`cents: true`, date as given; the API has no date filter, so it is applied client-side); `plan` takes `ctx.p` for the ids (`extId("ininja", acct, "txn", id)`). No new CRM or Budget fields.
- **Odoo (wave 4D).** `odoo` (`site: true`, `db: true`: the account row also carries `db`, "" or `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,62}`, sent as `X-Odoo-Database` via `L.extraHeaders(p, acct)`; address normalised like WooCommerce's, with a trailing `/odoo…`, `/web…` or `/json/2` dropped; root `/json/2` (Odoo 19's JSON-2 API); `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`), apps ["crm"]. Direct first (Odoo sends no CORS, so in practice one failed try, then the relay). `probe` may now be a whole request (`L.probeReq(p)`): Odoo's is a POST. Read-only allowlist: POST `/res.company/search_read`, `/res.partner/search_read`, `/crm.lead/search_read` only, each body exactly the fixed JSON in `L.ODOO` (domain, fields, `order: "id"`) plus `limit` 1–200 and `offset`; checkReq compares those as JSON (`"=<name>"` body kinds). `links/crm.js`: KINDS.odoo ["own", "orgs", "deals"], pages by offset (`read(p, kind, data, at)`), OPTIONAL.odoo.deals (no CRM app → no deals, not an error). Plan: the companies' own partners and their children stay out; a company → a customer with its child contacts (type contact) as `people`; a top-level non-company → a person customer; `afm` from `vat` (EL/GR prefix dropped), matched first; an opportunity → a deal (inactive = lost with its reason, probability 100 = won, else stage by probability), a contact's deal belongs to its company. No new CRM fields.
- **Todoist (wave 6A).** `todoist` (fixed host `api.todoist.com`, root `/api/v1`, `Authorization: Bearer <API token>` = 40 hex digits), apps ["todo"], probe `/projects?limit=1`. Direct first, the relay's ext op as fallback. Read-only allowlist: GET `/projects` and `/tasks` with `limit` (1–200) and `cursor` (base64; `%2B %2F %3D` only, like Pipedrive's). `links/todo.js` (`OrosLinksTodo`, pure, Node-tested in `tests/linkstodoist.test.js`): KINDS.todoist ["projects", "tasks"], pages by `next_cursor` (a cursor that doesn't move or isn't base64 ends the reading), MAX 1000 projects / 5000 tasks; `plan(st, got, ctx)` on To-Do's state: a project with open tasks → a list (`L.extId(p, acct, "list", id)`, Inbox first), a task → a task (`extId … "task"`): text ≤ 500, description → notes, `due.date` → due (date only), labels by name (any existing label of that name, else `extId … "label", lowercased name`), priority 4/3/2/1 → the task's own `prio` 1/2/3/(none) (since the To-Do TD-14 wave; before it, an extra-info field id `tdprio` value P1/P2/P3, which tasks imported then keep untouched); subtasks flat right after their parent; repeating tasks only their next date. Again: update (opt-in, default on) only text, notes, due, `prio`, labels only added; never `done`, other labels, info (the old `tdprio` field included) or recurrence. Deleted here (tombstone) → skipped unless `revive`; a new task whose text is open in its list → skipped (`here`). To-Do: `List settings › Import from Todoist…` (`todo/platforms.js`, `OrosTodoPlatforms`), applied by `importApply` in todo.js section 14 (ids from the plan, field stamps newest) with its own Undo (`undoFn`: added items, lists and labels tombstoned, updated fields put back).
- **Trello and GitHub (wave 6B).** `trello` (fixed host `api.trello.com`, root `/1`, keys `key` = 32 hex + `token` = 64–100 alphanumerics, header `Authorization: OAuth oauth_consumer_key="…", oauth_token="…"`, never in the query) and `github` (fixed host `api.github.com`, `Bearer` personal access token `github_pat_…` or `ghp_…`; the relay adds `X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28`), apps ["kanban"]. A platform with two secrets: `checkKeys` checks every key field, Settings shows a second `Token` field for Trello, and `links/host.js` viaRelay copies every key field of a fixed-host platform. Direct first, the relay's ext op as fallback. Read-only allowlist: Trello GET `/members/me/boards?filter=open&fields=name` and `/boards/<24 hex>` with the one fixed field list; GitHub GET `/user/repos` (`per_page` ≤ 100, `page`, `sort=updated`) and `/repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues` (`state=open|all`, `per_page`, `page`). `links/kanban.js` (`OrosLinksKanban`, pure, Node-tested in `tests/linkskanban.test.js`): `listReq/readList` (boards / non-archived repos, ≤ 10 pages), `boardReq`, `readIssues` (pull requests out, ≤ 10 pages of 100), `toExport(p, id, got, names)` → a Trello-export-shaped board, so Kanban's `Import from other apps` dialog takes it through `trelloAdapter` and the idempotent `importInto` like a file (ids `imp-t-<id>`; again: only missing columns, cards, labels; tombstones respected). GitHub: board `gh-<slug>`, columns `-open` / `-closed` (named by the app), issue → card `gh<id>` "#n title", body → notes, milestone `due_on` → due, labels `gh<id>`, body `- [ ]` / `- [x]` lines → subtasks. Kanban: `accountSection` in the import dialog (account, `Show boards`/`Show repositories`, board/repo, `Read`).
- **Raindrop.io (wave 6C).** `raindrop` (fixed host `api.raindrop.io`, root `/rest/v1`, `Authorization: Bearer <test token>` = 30–80 of `A-Za-z0-9-`), apps ["bookmarks"], probe `/collections`. Direct first, the relay's ext op as fallback. Read-only allowlist: GET `/collections`, `/collections/childrens` (no query) and `/raindrops/0` with `perpage` (1–50) and `page`. `links/bookmarks.js` (`OrosLinksBookmarks`, pure, Node-tested in `tests/linksraindrop.test.js`): KINDS.raindrop ["collections", "children", "raindrops"], bookmarks page while a page is full (MAX 5000); system collections (≤ 0) are not folders, the trash (−99) is skipped, links only http(s). `plan(st, got, ctx)` on Bookmarks' state: a collection → a folder by name (any existing folder of that name, case-insensitive, else `L.extId(p, acct, "folder", id)`; nested collections flat by their own name; Unsorted / unknown → `unsorted`), a bookmark → `extId … "bookmark"`: link, title (else the link), note (else excerpt, ≤ 1024), tags (≤ 12 × 32), `important` → `fav`; a link already here by Bookmarks' `dupeKey` → skipped (`here`). Again: update (opt-in, default on) only title and note, tags only added; never folder, fav, visits, pos. Deleted here (tombstone, item or its folder) → skipped unless `revive`. Bookmarks: the cloud button `Import from Raindrop.io…` (`bookmarks/platforms.js`, `OrosBookmarksPlatforms`, shown only inside the shell), applied by `platformApply` in bookmarks.js section 9 with its own Undo (`platformUndo`: added bookmarks tombstoned, added folders tombstoned while empty, updated fields put back).
- **Notion (wave 6D).** `notion` (fixed host `api.notion.com`, root `/v1`, `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` = `ntn_` or `secret_` + 30–80 alphanumerics; the relay adds `Notion-Version: 2022-06-28`), apps ["notes"], probe = the search with `page_size: 1`, `relayOnly` (Notion answers no browser). Read-only allowlist: `POST /search` whose body is exactly the fixed filter `{"property":"object","value":"page"}` (required, whole rule `ntq`) plus `page_size` (1–100, kind `nlim`) and `start_cursor` (UUID, kind `ncur`); `GET /blocks/<uuid>/children` with `page_size` ≤ 100 and a UUID `start_cursor`. `links/notes.js` (`OrosLinksNotes`, pure, Node-tested in `tests/linksnotion.test.js`): `searchReq/readSearch` (pages only; database rows, trash and odd ids out; title from the property of type title), `blocksReq/readBlocks`, `toText` (headings `#`, lists `-` / `n.`, to-dos `- [ ]`/`- [x]`, toggles `▸`, quotes and callouts `>`, code fences, dividers, table rows `a | b`, bookmarks as their link, media as `[Image] caption url` with Notion-hosted file links left out because they expire; children indented under list items, flat under containers), `plan(st, got, ctx)` on Notes' state: one notebook per account (`L.extId(p, acct, "notebook", "workspace")`, named Notion, created only with a first new page), a page → `extId … "page"` under its parent page when that came too (parents placed first), untitled → the app's word; again: same unless `upd` (opt-in, OFF by default: it replaces title and text, Undo puts them back), deleted page or notebook (tomb) → skipped unless `revive`. `notes/platforms.js` (`OrosNotesPlatforms`): search by cursor (MAX 300 pages), then a queue of block reads, 5 per relay call with 1.7 s between calls (relay 60 calls/min, Notion ~3 req/s), children of nesting blocks to depth 2, 5 pages of blocks per parent, "busy" retried twice; Notes: cloud button in the tree footer (shell only), `platformApply` / `platformUndo` in notes.js (Undo through the shell notice's action).
- **Notion databases (wave 6E).** Same `notion` platform, now apps ["notes", "spreadsheet"]. The search's filter may be either fixed value (okVal kind `"=nt_flt|nt_dbf"`: `"=a|b"` = exactly one of the listed fixed JSON values, in both copies), plus `POST /databases/<uuid>/query` whose body is only `page_size` (1–100) and a UUID `start_cursor`: no filter, no sort (an empty body is refused, so `page_size` always goes). `links/sheets.js` (`OrosLinksSheets`, pure, Node-tested in `tests/linksnotiondb.test.js`): `searchReq/readSearch` (databases, the title property first then the rest as Notion lists them, ≤ 64 columns; trash and odd ids out), `queryReq/readRows`, `valueOf` (title/rich text plain; number; select, status; multi-select and people and files joined with ", "; date `YYYY-MM-DD[ HH:MM]` with ` → ` for a range; checkbox `TRUE`/`FALSE`; url, email, phone; created/edited time and by; relation = the count; unique id `PREFIX-n`; formula and rollup by their own type), `cell` (one line, ≤ 500 chars, a leading = + - @ gets an apostrophe: the same rule as BR-S1 `tableCell`), `table` (row 1 = names, ≤ 499 rows), `plan(st, got, ctx)` on `{ sheets: { id: values }, deleted }`: a database → sheet `L.extId(p, acct, "sheet", id)` named by its title (Excel-safe, ≤ 31), else the app's word; again: same unless `upd` (opt-in, OFF: the sheet's values become the database's, formats and name stay), a deleted sheet (Spreadsheet's `deleted[id]`) → skipped unless `revive`. `spreadsheet/platforms.js` (`OrosSheetPlatforms`): search by cursor (MAX 20 databases), then a queue of queries 5 per relay call with 1.7 s between calls, 5 pages per database. Spreadsheet: the `Notion` button next to CSV/XL (shell only); `platformApply` writes new sheets (row 1 bold) and replaced values (rawSet, keeping formats; extra cells deleted), `platformUndo` deletes the new sheets (tombstoned) and restores the old cells, through the shell notice's action.
- **Notion database → Kanban (wave 6F).** Same `notion` platform and the same two read-only requests as 6E (no relay change); apps ["notes", "spreadsheet", "kanban"]. `links/kanban.js` (needs `links/sheets.js` for `searchReq`, `queryReq`, `readSearch`, `valueOf`): `listReq("notion", n, cursor)`, `readList` → items `{ id, name, props }` (the database's schema, kept for the board) with `next`, `boardReq("notion", id, n, cursor)`, `readRows`, `toExport("notion", id, { db, rows }, names)` → a Trello-export-shaped board `nt-<hex id>`: a list per option of the first `status` property (else first `select`; ids `-o-<option id>`; an option missing from the schema gets its own list), rows without a value in `-none` (named by the app; `Cards` when there is no grouping property), a row → card `nt<hex page id>` named by its title, first `date` start as due, first `multi_select` as labels (`-l-<option id>`, Notion colours mapped to Trello's names, brown → orange), every other non-empty property as "Name: value" lines in the notes plus the page's notion.so link; no checklists. Kanban's `accountSection` pages the list and the rows by cursor (MAX_PAGES 10 each) and lands the board through `trelloAdapter` and the idempotent merge, like Trello and GitHub.
- **GitHub issues → To-Do (wave 6G).** Same `github` platform as 6B, now apps ["kanban", "todo"]; one more read-only rule in the allowlist (app and relay copies): GET `/issues` with `filter=assigned`, `state=open`, `per_page` ≤ 100, `page` (the open issues assigned to the token's owner across every repository it can see). `links/todo.js` (Node-tested in `tests/linksghtodo.test.js`): `KINDS.github = ["tasks"]`, `req("github", "tasks", page)`, `read` pages while a page is full (≤ 50 pages), pull requests, closed issues and odd repository names left out; an issue → task `"#n title"`, body + `html_url` as notes, label names as labels, milestone `due_on` as due, priority normal. `plan` makes one list per repository (`owner/name`, name order; ids from `extId`), then the same rules as Todoist: again adds only what is new, updates only when asked, deleted lists and tasks stay out unless "revive". To-Do's `Import from Todoist or GitHub…` dialog switches its intro and update hint by the account's platform.
- **Invoices → myDATA.** `links/mydata.js` (`OrosMyData`, pure, Node-tested in `tests/mydata.test.js`): `build(o)` → `{ok, body, errs}` (one SendInvoices document; each VAT rate's base and VAT shared over its lines by largest remainder so the lines match orOS's `totals()` to the cent; withholding as taxesTotals taxType 1; 5.1 correlated by numeric ΜΑΡΚ), `autoType`, `classOf` (E3 + category1_1 goods / category1_3 services), `parseSend` (ok / offline / dup (AADE 228) / rejected / tech / bad / auth; the PDF URL must be on a provider host), `findSent`, `seriesOf` (Greek capitals → Latin, e.g. "INV-2026"). `invoices/mydata-ui.js` (`OrosInvoicesMyData`): the Send dialog, Check, the viewer card. Doc extras (ride through `withExtras`, strings): `mds` (`"?"` written BEFORE the call, then `"ok"` or `"off"`), `mdx` (account id), `mdt` (type), `mdq` ("SERIES/aa" as sent), `mdu` (UID), `mda` (authentication code), `mdp` (official PDF link); `mark` holds the ΜΑΡΚ. A document with `mds` is locked: no Cancel (a credit note is offered), no renumber, the number-clash fix keeps it.
- **Adobe files without an account (wave 5A).** Adobe has no public API for third-party apps to read a user's Creative Cloud libraries, so orOS reads and writes Adobe's own file formats instead; no key, no relay. `atelier/swatches.js` (`AtelierSwatches`, pure, Node-tested in `tests/adobefiles.test.js`): `read(bytes)` → `[{name, c}]` from `.ase` (ASEF; RGB, CMYK, Gray, LAB; groups flattened) or `.aco` (v1 and v2; RGB, HSB, CMYK, Lab, Gray), every count and length checked against the bytes left, max 2000, Error("swatch") otherwise; `writeAse(colors, group)` → one group of RGB global colours. Atelier Brand kit: `Import swatches` (≤4 MB, `BK.addColor` each, so duplicates and the 40-colour limit apply) and `Save as swatches` (`AT.io.saveBlob`). `photolab/xmp.js` (`PhotoLab.xmp`, pure): `parse(text)` → `{name, layers, skipped}` for a Lightroom / Camera Raw preset (needs the camera-raw-settings namespace, ≤2 MB; values read only when plain numbers, clamped): levels (Exposure2012, Whites2012, Blacks2012), curves (Contrast2012, Shadows2012, Highlights2012; ToneCurvePV2012 sampled at 64/128/192), balance ((Incremental)Temperature/Tint), hsl (Saturation + half Vibrance), gray (ConvertToGrayscale); groups with no layer (clarity, texture, dehaze, sharpen, noise, grain, vignette, mixer, grading) are listed in `skipped` when changed from Lightroom's defaults. Photo Lab `Adjust › Lightroom preset (.xmp)…` → `PL.io.openLrPreset()` → `PL.ops.addAdjLayers(list, label, prefix)`: normalised adjustment layers above the active layer in one undo step, named "<preset> · <kind>". PSD layered read was already there (`photolab/psd.js`).
- **PowerPoint export for Canva (wave 5B).** `atelier/pptxout.js` (`AtelierPPTXOut`, pure, Node-tested in `tests/atelier-pptxout.test.js` by reading the file back with `atelier/pptx.js`): `needs(doc)` → `{assets, raster}`, `kindOf(it)`, `build(doc, media, {pages})` → `{bytes, out:{native, raster, missing}, scale}`; `atelier/zip.js` gained `write(files)` (stored ZIP, CRC-32). Native: text boxes (font by name, size, b/i/u, caps, alignment, line height as spcPct = lh/1.2, tracking as spc, colour + alpha, shadow/lift as outerShdw), shapes (rect/ellipse/roundRect presets, every other Atelier shape as custGeom from `fx.shapePath`; fill, gradient with `lin ang = g.ang − 90`, outline, dash), photos (srcRect crop from the image rect, flips, shape mask, alphaModFix), lines (cxnSp, head/tail ends triangle/oval), page background (bgPr colour or gradient; a background photo as the first picture). The caller (`io.js` `exportPptx`) supplies the stored image bytes and draws icons, curved text, other text effects, filtered/adjusted photos and videos alone as PNGs (`rasterItem`, ≤3000 px side, padded, unrotated; the slide rotates them). Slide = the design's size, scaled as a whole past PowerPoint's 1–56 in limits. Download dialog type `PPTX` (no size options); the toast says how many elements went out as pictures. No account, key or relay; replaces the planned Canva Connect upload.

### Assistant app (`assistant/`, 0.63.00)
- **What:** "Assistant" / «Βοηθός», System. Chat with the AI the user picks, called straight from the browser with the user's own key (no orOS server): Claude (Anthropic Messages API, `anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access`), OpenAI, Gemini (`streamGenerateContent?alt=sse`), Mistral, OpenRouter, or "Local / OpenAI-compatible" (Ollama, LM Studio; base URL, key optional). Streaming SSE, Stop, conversation list.
- **Files:** `core.js` (pure, node-tested: providers, slice merge, permissions, request builders, SSE + reducers, errors, model lists, tools, safe Markdown, system prompt), `assistant.js` (UI), `assistant.css`, help pages.
- **Tools offered to the model:** `search_data {query, apps?}` and `list_apps`. Search runs the universal search providers through the shell (`orosAssistSearch`). Writes: none (phase 1). Max 6 model↔tool rounds per question.
- **Consent (AS-C):** results from apps set to "Ask first" are shown on a card ("Share with …?") with a checkbox per item; only the ticked items reach the provider. "Always share from … without asking" sets those apps to Always. Apps at "Never" are not searched; Mail, Passwords and the Assistant itself are never offered (`NEVER_APPS`). Sensitive apps (`searchOff` in apps.json: Mood, Cycle, Health, Baby, Budget) start at Never. "Chat only" removes the tools.
- **Rendering (AS-R):** answers are parsed by `parseMd` into tokens and drawn with `textContent` only. No HTML, no images, ever. Links: `oros:rN` (a ref a search returned, opens the item through `orosAssistOpen`) and http(s) (new tab, `noopener noreferrer`); anything else is plain text. Tool results are labelled as data in the system prompt (prompt injection), and the assistant has no tool that reaches the network.
- **Anthropic specifics:** raw content blocks (thinking + signature) are echoed back unchanged (append-only history); server-side fallback header only for the models that support it; `stop_reason: "refusal"` → a note.
- **Deep link:** `__orosOpenAt("assistant", { ask: "text" })` puts the text in the message box (never sends by itself).
- **Tools (since phase 2, 0.67.00):** `search_data`, `list_apps`, `read_item {ref}` (only while the user lets it search data) and `propose_entry {kind, …}` (only while at least one receiving app is installed; also in "Chat only"). Max 6 model↔tool rounds per question (unchanged).
- **AS-E (entry cards):** `propose_entry` never writes. `core.normEntry(args, {from, has})` checks the arguments with the receiving bridge's own rules and builds its call; a failed check goes back to the model as an error and shows no card. The card shows exactly what will be sent; "Open in …" re-runs `normEntry` on the stored arguments (a stored or synced chat is never trusted as it is), saves the chat, then calls the bridge; "Dismiss" only marks the card. Kinds → bridges: todo → `__orosOpenAt("todo", {addItems})` (BR-TD-ADD, `from` = "Assistant"/«Βοηθός»), event → `__orosOpenCalendarNew` (BR-W8), expense / income → `__orosOpenBudgetNew` (BR-B1, `src: "assistant"`, category names map to Budget's ready ids), quote → `__orosOpenQuoteNew` (BR-Q1, any 3-letter ISO currency since wave 46), sheet → `__orosOpenAt("spreadsheet", {newSheet})` (BR-S1, ≤ 499 rows × 64 cols, numeric strings become numbers, the receiver escapes `= + - @`), slides → `__orosOpenAt("slides", {outline, title})`, bookmark → `__orosOpenAt("bookmarks", {add:{url,title}})` (http/https only), note → `__orosOpenAt("notes", {add:{title,text}})`. To-Do, Calendar, Budget, Quote and Bookmarks open their form (nothing saved until the user saves; BR-W8-6); Notes and Spreadsheet create the page / sheet on the card's click, Slides asks for a theme first. Card state (`""|opened|dismissed|failed`) is kept in the chat.
- **AS-R2 (read_item):** finds the item again by the search's query and hit id (refs keep `{app, target, title, q, id}`), sends at most 12 000 characters; an "Ask first" app shows one more card with the beginning and the size. Apps set to Never or no longer readable answer with an error. No provider `get()` was needed: every search provider already returns the item's full plain text.
- **Ask from anywhere:** the menu search's last row "Ask the Assistant: «q»" (`.menu-ask`, only when the Assistant is installed) and Ctrl+Alt+Shift+A both open the Assistant; the row passes `{ask: q}` (the text lands in the message box, nothing is sent).
- **Unconfigured device:** a synced conversation can be read without a key; only sending needs setup.
- **AS-SUM (app_summary, phase 3):** tool `app_summary {app, month?: "YYYY-MM", days?: 1–31}`, offered with data access when a readable app has a summary; `list_apps` marks those apps `summary: true`. `assistant/summary.js` (OrosAssistSummary, pure) works it out on the device, read-only: Budget = income, expenses, net and each category of one month (budget/search.js names and tombstone rule, entries only, recurring rules not projected); Timesheet = hours, billable hours and amount per project of one month with the app's own rounding (`OrosTimesheetCore.report`, the core is loaded on first use from `../timesheet/core.js`); To-Do = open / done / late / due-today in total and per list, plus its agenda; every other app with a Today provider = its agenda: late tasks, today and the next `days` days (past events dropped, ≤ 60 rows), through `orosToday.agenda(appId, days)`. Permissions are the assistant's own per app: "Always" shares, "Ask first" shows the summary lines on a card (Share / Don't share), "Never" answers with an error naming the setting. Agenda rows with a target get a ref (`oros:rN`), so the answer can link them. Only the summary leaves the device.
- **Entry kind invoice (phase 3, request from the Invoices thread):** `propose_entry {kind: "invoice", lines, currency?, client?, note?}` → `__orosOpenAt("invoices", {new: {name?, items: [{d, q, p}], cur?, notes?}})` (BR-INV-NEW; prices in currency units, Invoices adds its VAT). Checked like Invoices' `normPrefill`: 1–50 lines with text, 0 < qty ≤ 100000, 0 ≤ price ≤ 10 000 000, currency one of Invoices' 16. Opens a new draft (and the New client dialog for an unknown client); nothing is saved until the user saves.
- **Copy:** every answer has a `Copy` button (the answer's Markdown as written; navigator.clipboard, textarea fallback).
- **Built-in browser model (phase 3):** provider `browser` ("Built-in browser model" / «Ενσωματωμένο μοντέλο του browser»), Chrome's Prompt API (`window.LanguageModel`): no key, no address, no network; chat only (no tools, its own system prompt line). One session per answer: system prompt + earlier turns as `initialPrompts`, the last user message streamed with `promptStreaming`, then `destroy()`. Settings show its state from `availability()` (ready / downloadable with a "Download the model" button that shows progress / not in this browser). Older devices drop the unknown provider id on their own merge (harmless: a pull never marks dirty).
- **Ask from Writer:** with the Assistant installed, Writer's toolbar gets `#btn-ask` (sparkle, before Settings): Summarize / Rephrase / Fix spelling & grammar / Ask something else… put the selected text (else the whole document, ≤ 12 000 characters) and the request into the Assistant's message box through `__orosOpenAt("assistant", {ask})`. Nothing is sent until the user presses Send. The `ask` text cap is now 20 000 characters (was 2 000).
- **AS-CHG (change_item, wave 48).** Tool `change_item {ref, action: complete|reopen|reschedule|update|delete, title?, date?, start?, end?, location?, note?, amount?, category?}`, offered with data access when a readable, installed app takes changes (`todo`, `calendar`, `budget`, `bookmarks`); the system prompt names them (otherwise it still says "You cannot change or delete anything"). Pure logic in `assistant/edits.js` (`OrosAssistEdits`, Node-tested in `tests/assistant-edits.test.js`): `normArgs` (shape), `plan(app, data, target, ch)` → `{ title, before, after, rows: [{f, b, a}], del }` (`buildDiff`, fixed field order; a delete lists what the item had), `apply(..., expect)` (the same change on the data as it is NOW; a record whose view differs from what the user saw → `conflict`, nothing written), `undo(app, data, u)` (only while the record still has the values the change left). **Rules:** (1) only an item the user already shared in this conversation (a ref of search_data / app_summary; the ref keeps `{app, target}`); (2) nothing is written before the user presses Apply / Delete on the before → after card, whatever the app's permission ("Always share" is about reading); Stop = no; (3) the model gets back only `{ref, applied, action}` or an error / refusal reason, never the before values; (4) the write follows each app's own sync contract: To-Do per-field stamps `fm` (TD-3, older-code tasks spelled out from `mtime` first) + `mtime`, tombstone `deleted[id]` newer than the task, keys sorted (TD-4), Undo of a delete = `stampItemNewest` at the old index, `pos` re-numbered, list `om`; Calendar whole-event `mtime`, tombstone `{id, mtime}`, reschedule keeps the length and a multi-day span; Budget tx `m`, `tombs["tx:<id>"]`, tx sorted by id, tombs sorted, key order kept; Bookmarks `modified`, `deleted[id]`, keys sorted. Every stamp = `max(now, old + 1)`. The app is closed while the Assistant runs (one app frame), so its stored copy is what the closed-app proxy pushes; `orosSync.markDirty()` after each write. (5) Refused with a plain reason (the app does it): ticking a repeating task, moving / deleting a repeating event, a recurring Budget entry, an entry with receipts (`rc`) or a foreign amount (`oc`), a bookmark with a saved copy (`arch`); Notes, Kanban, documents and every other app take no changes. (6) Undo lives in memory (`undoMem`, this session only): a stored or synced conversation never carries a way to write; after Undo the stored tool result is rewritten ("applied, then undone") so the model hears it next turn. Cards: `.chg-card` (confirm card in the turn, the safe button focused; result card with `Undo` while possible).
- **AS-VOICE (wave 48).** `#mic-btn` next to Send: Web Speech API (`SpeechRecognition` / `webkitSpeechRecognition`), `lang` el-GR / en-US by the UI language, interim results into the message box, never sends. Hidden without the API (Firefox). The first use shows a dialog saying the browser usually sends the audio to its own speech service (not orOS, not the AI); the "yes" is the device-local pref `voiceOk` in `oros-assistant-prefs`. Errors: not-allowed → "microphone blocked", no-speech → a note. Send / Enter / pagehide stop listening. Same-origin app frame: the microphone permission is the shell origin's.
