- **FITNESS v1** (slice `fitness`, key `oros-fitness-data`): `{ ver: 1, ex: [{ id, m, n, g, k, h }], pg: [{ id, m, n, days }], wo: [{ id, m, d, st, en, ti, p, pd, n, x: [{ e, tr, tr2, rest, s: [...] }] }], bm: [{ id: "2026-10-09", m, w, wa, ch, ar }], set: { m, wu, du, incU, incL, rest, hb } | null, tombs: { "<coll>:<id>": m } }`; all quantities are integers (grams, metres, millimetres, seconds). `mergeFit`: per collection LWW by `m` (equal `m`: larger canonical JSON), tombstones max-merged and a tomb ≥ `m` wins; `set` LWW as a whole.
  - **Wave 29 (supersets, progression programs, outdoor GPS):** optional fields, written only when set so older rows keep their canonical JSON: program item / workout entry `ln: 1` (linked to the next one: superset of 2, circuit of 3+; the last entry's link is ignored); workout entry `pk` (`"m|a|t1|t2|t3|l:<exercise>"`, the plan slot), `pr` (prescribed reps per working set), `am: 1` (last working set is "+"); workout `pl` (plan id) + `pp` (plan position it was started at), `g: { a: "walk"|"run"|"ride", ps: 0|1, sg: ["<segment>"] }`. New collection `pl: [{ id, m, n, tp: "531"|"gzclp"|"lin", rd (plate step, g), bb: 0|1, k (sessions done), tm{lift: g}, sl{"t1:x-squat": {w, lv 0–2, b, f}}, fl{lift: 1} }]`, LWW + `pl:<id>` tombs like the others; the `pl` key is left out of the slice while empty (data without programs keeps its old canonical form).
  - Shared pure cores (Node-tested in `tests/fitness-wave29.test.js`): `fitness/plan-core.js` (`OrosFitnessPlan`: templates 5/3/1 (TM %, warm-ups, "+" sets, deload, +1 step per 4-week cycle or −10% for a lift whose "+" set missed, optional BBB 5×10 @ 50%), GZCLP (T1 5×3+ → 6×2+ → 10×1+ → 85% reset; T2 3×10 → 3×8 → 3×6 → last 3×10 weight + 3 upper steps; T3 3×15+, +1 upper step at 25 reps), Linear 5×5 (A/B, +step on success, −10% after 3 misses in a row); `advance` only when `wo.pl === plan.id && wo.pp === plan.k`, so a workout counts once; rounding to `rd`; superset flow `groupsOf / flowOrder / nextAfter / restAfter / groupRest`: a group is run round by round and rests after the round with the last exercise's rest); `fitness/gps-core.js` (`OrosFitnessGps`: segments as delta-coded integer triples lat×1e6, lon×1e6, s since start in the polyline varint alphabet; distance and time summed per segment so pauses count in neither; splits per km / mile by interpolation; reuses Maps' `maps/tracks-core.js` unchanged for `distM`, the recording filter `accept`, Douglas-Peucker (finished tracks thinned to 2 m) and `writeGpx`); `fitness/wger.js` (`OrosFitnessWger`, see below).
  - Outdoor session: `watchPosition` (high accuracy) runs only on the device whose `oros-fitness-prefs.gps` is that workout; the live segment is written into the row every 10 s and on hide (sync paced as for any running workout); `Finish` puts distance and moving time into the single `x-run` / `x-walk` / `x-bike` set, so records, charts, CSV and Health Connect use them unchanged. GPX export = Maps' writer with `creator="orOS Workouts"`. Decision: no map tiles under the route preview (offline, no third-party request); the help says plainly that browsers may stop GPS when the screen is off.
  - Exercise pictures (wger.de, CC BY-SA): only on "Show picture"; search `/api/v2/exercise/search/?language=en&term=` (ready exercises by their English name) then `/api/v2/exerciseinfo/<id>/` for author and licence, shown next to the image with links. JSON direct from the browser, then (CORS refused) the Reader's `feeds/fetch.js` relay "web" op loaded by path (no relay change); images are plain `<img>` (the relay refuses images) and kept in Cache Storage `oros-fitness-pics` when the server allows CORS. Per-exercise result (or "none", asked again after 30 days) in device-local `oros-fitness-pics`, never synced.
- **BABY v1** (slice `baby`, key `oros-baby-data`, since 0.47.00): `{ ver, kids[{id, n, b, s, c, m}], ev[{id, k, t, ts, e?, ls?, rs?, cur?, cs?, sd?, ml?, x?, v?, tx?, m}], gr[{id, k, d, g?, l?, h?, m}], mk[{id, k, t, key?, tx?, d, nt?, m}], prefs{wu, tu, vu}, pm }`. Arrays sorted by id; a tombstone is `{id, m, del:1}` (delete wins equal m; a newer edit resurrects). Event types: feed, bottle, solid, sleep, diaper, pump, med, temp, bath, tummy, note. A running timer (feed, sleep) is an event without `e`; a running breast feed also has `cur` (side) and `cs` (segment start); `ls`/`rs` are banked seconds per side, `sd` the last side. Units stored metric (ml, g, mm, tenths of °C); `prefs` are display units only. Deleting a child tombstones the child and all its records. Restore from a JSON backup goes through `mergeBaby` (never removes). Core 1.1.0 (0.57.03) adds `readRem`, `reminderDue`, `reminderText`, `calendarRows`; slice unchanged.
  - Wave 34: a pump's length (1–180 min) is its end `e` (older builds already keep `e` on a non-timer event with e > ts, so nothing is lost; the CSV "minutes" column shows it). New list `st` = the family's milk stash (no kid): `{id, ml 1–1000, d pumped, w "f" fridge | "z" freezer, u use-by, s? "u" used | "x" thrown away, sd? that day, th? thawed day, tx?, m}`, per bag LWW + `{id, m, del: 1}` tombstones like every list (`core.normSt`, `mergeBaby`); the key sits between `mk` and `prefs` and is LEFT OUT while the merged list is empty, so a slice that never had a bag keeps its bytes (no upload at update). Use-by defaults (`core.useBy`, CDC guidance): fridge 4 days, freezer 6 months; `thaw` = to the fridge, use-by today + 1 (never later than before). Order (`stashBags`): fridge first, then earliest use-by, then oldest pumped; expired bags flagged, "soon" = use-by ≤ tomorrow. "Use" can log a breast-milk bottle (Undo toast with an extra action). Tests: `tests/baby-stash.test.js`.
- **FAMTREE v1:** `{ ver, trees[{id,m,name,home}], people[{id,m,tree,given,family,birthName,sex f|m|x|u,birth{d,q,place},death{d,q,place},dead,note,photo,contact,parents[{u,kind birth|adopted|foster|step}]}], unions[{id,m,tree,a,b,kind married|partner|divorced|unknown,start{d,q},end{d,q}}], tombs{} }`. Dates `YYYY | YYYY-MM | 2026-10-09` (year 1–2200), q `"" | abt | bef | aft`. Photos: canvas-re-encoded JPEG data URI ≤ 28,000 chars, all photos ≤ 1.4M chars. JSON file `{ app:"familytree", format:1, exported, trees, people, unions, tombs }`; import = allow-list rebuild + merge (restore is a merge).
  - GEDCOM (`.ged`, since 0.53.02): import = GEDCOM 5.5.1 / 7.0 (UTF-8, UTF-16, ANSEL, ANSI/Windows-1252), ≤ 15 MB, always into ONE NEW tree named after the file; reads INDI NAME (TYPE birth/maiden → birthName), SEX, BIRT, DEAT/BURI/CREM (→ dead), NOTE (inline or record), FAMC+PEDI; FAM HUSB/WIFE/CHIL (+_FREL/_MREL), MARR (→ married), DIV (→ divorced), else kind unknown; dates ABT/CAL/EST/BET/FROM → abt, BEF/TO → bef, AFT → aft, dual years → new-style year, non-Gregorian/Julian and day-month-only dates dropped; same checks as JSON import (refs, loops, caps). Export = GEDCOM 5.5.1 UTF-8 CRLF of one tree, optional "hide details of the living"; sex x → U, step parent → `_FREL/_MREL Step`, partner union → FAM without MARR.
- **GARAGE v1** (slice `garage`, key `oros-garage-data`, since 0.47.00): `{ ver: 1, vehicles[], fuel[], service[], plans[], tyres[], renewals[], costs[], odo[], settings{m, cur}, tombs{id: ms} }`. Every row has `id` (`[a-z0-9]{1,40}`) and `m` (mtime, R27: only bumped on a real change); child rows carry `v` (vehicle id). Dates are `2026-10-09`; money is integer cents; km are integers.
  - Since 0.52.01, fuel / service / cost rows may carry `rc`: up to 6 receipt file NAMES (`YYYYMMDD-<rowId>-<random>.jpg`, `core.RC_RE`), sorted and unique. The key is absent when there are none, so older rows keep their canonical form. Files live on the orOS disk at `/internal/Garage/Receipts/<name>` (Files; synced by Vault Drive when the user runs it). The row is LWW as a whole. Photos are re-drawn on a canvas (long side ≤ 1600 px, JPEG 0.8, white background), so no EXIF or location data and no foreign bytes are kept. A photo added in an editor that is then cancelled is removed. A photo taken off a row leaves the disk on save. A deleted row's photos leave the disk after the Undo window when no row points at them. A photo missing on a device shows "Not on this device".
  - vehicle `{name, type (car|moto|scooter|van|truck|camper|tractor|boat|bike|ebike|escooter|other), fuel (petrol|diesel|lpg|cng|hybrid|phev|ev|none), make, model, year, plate, tank (L), col 0–7, arch 0|1, notes}` (max 30).
  - fuel `{d, km, q (thousandths: mL or Wh), c, e f|e, full 1|0, mis 1 = an earlier fill was not logged, st, n, bud}`. Consumption is full-to-full; `mis` breaks the chain.
  - service `{d, km|null, items[] (fixed catalogue), c, shop, n, bud}`; plan `{item, km, mo (one at least), sd, skm|null, label}`: due counted from the newest service holding the item, else from `sd`/`skm`; km due uses km/day over the last 365 days (readings at least 14 days apart).
  - tyre `{label, season s|w|a, size, brand, dot WWYY, tread, km (earlier mounted periods), on, okm}`.
  - renewal `{kind (kteo|ins|tax|kek|road|lic|other), exp, every (months, 0 = once), label, c, prov, ref, warn[] (days, max 4, default [30,7,1]), n}`. Renewing writes a cost with a FIXED id `(renewalId + "x" + exp digits).slice(-40)` and moves `exp` by `every`, so the same renewal done on two offline devices merges into one cost.
  - cost `{d, cat, c ≥ 1, km|null, n, bud}`; odo `{d, km}`.
  - `bud` = the row was sent to Budget (prefill the user confirms; the app asks before resending).
  - Join: `garage/core.js` `merge` (own keys only, strict normalizers drop anything malformed). Tests: `tests/garage.test.js`.
  - Wave 34 (no schema change): `garage/receipt.js` (`OrosGarageReceipt.parse(text, today)`) reads the TEXT of a fuel / charging receipt (Greek or English; pasted or typed) into `{d, q, p, c, st, e?, found[]}` for the fuel editor to prefill: "q LT X p" lines, a number before a unit (L, LT, Λ, λίτρα, kWh), labels (Ποσότητα / Volume, Τιμή μον. / Price/L, €/L), the last labelled total (ΣΥΝΟΛΟ / ΠΛΗΡΩΤΕΟ / TOTAL; ΦΠΑ / VAT / cash / change lines never), the first valid date not after today (day first, month first as a fallback), a known brand or the first name-like line. Two of quantity / price / total give the third; when all three disagree, quantity and total win. Nothing is saved before Save. Photo OCR is not wired here: `vendor/tesseract/` (Contacts wave 26) is not in this branch; the receipt dialog is the place a recognised text would go.
  - Wave 34: `garage/logbook.js` (`OrosGarageLogbook.build / html / page`) = the printable logbook of one vehicle (vehicle, summary, every service oldest first, renewals, tyres; optional fuel fills, other costs, amounts). Every data text is escaped there; print goes through `#print-area` (only it prints, emptied on `afterprint`), "Save as HTML" through `orosDialog.saveFile` (a self-contained page with inline CSS and no script). Tests: `tests/garage-receipt.test.js`.

  - Slice `shelf` (oros-shelf-data): `{ ver, items[{id, m, a, type (book|film|series|album|podcast|game), title (≤ 200), by (≤ 120), year, size (pages / minutes / episodes / tracks / hours), fmt (book: p|e|a), plat (game, ≤ 40), st (want|now|done|drop), prio, rate (0–10 half stars), fav, tags (≤ 10 × 30), rev (≤ 4000), src (≤ 200), col (0–9)}] sorted by id, sess[{id, m, it, k (s start|p progress|d done|x drop), d (local 2026-10-09), v (p only)}] sorted by id, goals{"YYYY-type": {m, n}} sorted, tombs{id: deletedAt} shared by items and sessions }`, at most 5,000 items.

  - The current page / episode / hour count is NEVER stored: it is the highest `v` since the latest start, so two devices logging different values converge on the higher one. A lower value typed by the user is a correction: the run's higher progress rows are tombstoned. Each `d` row is one finish (re-reads count); statistics, pace and goal state are derived.
  - **1.2.0 (0.62.00, #142):** items gain optional `rel` ("YYYY-MM-DD", present only when set). Unknown item fields ride along (forward-compatible, same rule as Budget): name `[a-z][a-z0-9]{0,15}`, value string ≤ 500 / finite number / boolean, at most 16, sorted after the known keys. External service: "Find details online" calls Open Library (openlibrary.org, books) and MusicBrainz (musicbrainz.org, albums) with only the typed title and creator, no API key, opt-in (first tap shows a note and sets device-local `oros-shelf-prefs`.lk = 1; listed under external services in Settings).

Items gain optional known keys, each present only when valid: `cov` (cover image URL, https `upload.wikimedia.org` or `image.tmdb.org` only, ≤ 500), with it `cvby` (artist, plain text ≤ 120), `cvlc` (licence short name ≤ 60), `cvpg` (https `commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/…` file page); `wd` (Wikidata id `Q\d+`), `tmdb` (`movie/<id>` | `tv/<id>`). A `cov` that fails the check drops the whole credit set; older 1.2–1.4 devices carry the keys as extras (≤ 16, strings ≤ 500), so nothing is lost either way. Merge unchanged (LWW per item). Sources: Wikidata (`wbsearchentities` → `wbgetentities` claims: P31 class filter, P577 date, P2047 runtime (films), P1113 episodes (series), P57 director / P170 creator, P3383 poster or P18 image → a second call for the people's labels; a picked date also fills `rel`) + Wikimedia Commons `imageinfo` (thumb 320 px, extmetadata Artist stripped to text, LicenseShortName), no key, opt-in note once (`oros-shelf-prefs`.lkw = 1); TMDB v3 search + details (films with `append_to_response=credits`) only with the user's own key or read token, kept DEVICE-LOCAL in `oros-shelf-tmdb` (never synced, never in backups through the slice; v3 key as `api_key`, a token > 40 chars as `Authorization: Bearer`); `oros-shelf-prefs`.lks = "wd" | "tmdb" (chosen source). Credits shown in the item dialog (Commons artist · licence · file page link; "Details: Wikidata (CC0)"; TMDB link + "This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB."). Images load with `referrerpolicy=no-referrer`, lazily, and fall back to the generated cover on error. Reading stats derived, never stored: `pagesByDay` (page deltas of p/d rows per book, audiobooks excluded), `readingSummary` (total, days, best day, per day, streak, last 30 days), `goalPlan` (left, days left, per week / month, pages a day from `avgBookPages`, projection); Now tab shows the year's book goal strip. Tests: `tests/shelf-online.test.js`.

Merge: LWW per record by m, tombstones (R17), read cut max/max, explicit marks LWW, marks under the cut dropped, compact() folds runs >= 20. Article bodies are device-local (IDB), never synced.

Own slice for the same reason as the brand kit. Merge per folder and per place by m, ties by canonical JSON; a tombstone removes a folder not newer than it; a place naming a missing folder counts as no folder. Which folder is open stays per device.
- **ATELIER-BRAND v1** (slice `atelier-brand`, key `oros-atelier-brand`, owner `atelier/brandkit.js`): `{ver:1, colors[{id,m,c,pos}] ≤ 40, fonts{h|s|t:{f,b,m}}, logos[{id,m,a,w,h,nm,pos}] ≤ 20, dt{id:m}}`. Own slice because the design slice's merge drops unknown top-level fields. Merge per entry / font slot by m, ties by canonical JSON, tombstones remove entries not newer. Video / sound clips are Vault files at `/internal/Assets/<sha256>.<ext>` (type sniffed from bytes; ≤ 100 MB video, 30 MB sound, 30 min); design items reference them via `ax.vid/vs/ve/mu/vol/nl`, page sound `ax.au/av/ao`, validated in `normAx`.
